text:
alex: quick q — where's the compact prefetch/prefix cache dashboard? alert for high miss-rate fired on staging earlier and I can't find short panels to triage :eyes:

maria: there's a small panel set in the 'kv-prefetch' folder in Grafana. link: https://grafana.redwood/ d/kv-prefetch/compact?orgId=1 (bookmark that one)

alex: thanks — which panel shows 'hotkey' vs 'prefix' misses? I only see a generic hit-rate

tara: the hotkey/prefix split is the 2nd row, "Hit rate by key_type". if you want a quick calc, use this prom query in Explore:

```
sum(rate(kv_prefetch_hits_total{env=\"staging\"}[5m])) by (key_type)
/ sum(rate(kv_prefetch_requests_total{env=\"staging\"}[5m])) by (key_type)
```

mike: fyi alert `kv_prefetch_miss_high` is set to 8% for prod, 12% for staging. we got a noisy firing earlier — we should probably adjust the staging window before paging. :warning:

alex: who owns that alert? want to loop in oncall

tara: @mike owns alert defs, @sophia owns dashboards. tagging @oncall-eng for visibility :bell:

sophia: I can prune some panels and add a smaller "triage" row. Will add a short note w/ links. ETA EOD today.

alex: perfect. also, any quick trick to check KV eviction spikes? I saw evictions jump in logs around the same time.

maria: check the `kv_evictions_total` series and correlate with `eviction_latency_ms`. quick promql: `increase(kv_evictions_total{job=\"kvstore\"}[1h])`

alex: great, thanks all :rocket:
